page_title: NOT 0-2 MCI | Nottingham Forest v Manchester City 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' It looks like Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
89' A substitution has been made. Kevin De Bruyne is replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
89' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) replacing Julian Alvarez.
88' Ola Aina (Nottingham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

87' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Stefan Ortega makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top right corner.
85' Rodri (Manchester City) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Willy Boly as he is replaced by Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham).

82' Manchester City hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Willy Boly (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
76' Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
74' It's time for a substitution. Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) comes on in place of Anthony Elanga.
74' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Murillo will be replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham).
74' Substitution. Danilo walks off the pitch and Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes on as a substitute.
71' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Kevin De Bruyne tees up Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Matz Sels.
69' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

68' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Matz Sels was alert and the score remains the same. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
63' That was close by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
62' That will be all from Jack Grealish who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Erling Haaland (Manchester City).
61' Ola Aina (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Nottingham are taking a throw-in.
59' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
58' Willy Boly (Nottingham) commits a rough foul. Simon Hooper stops the game and makes a call.
57' Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
52' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
51' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
47' Chris Wood (Nottingham) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
46' Half-time substitution. Pep Guardiola decided to make a change. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is replaced by Mateo Kovacic.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ederson (Manchester City) is replaced by Stefan Ortega.
46' Referee Simon Hooper blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Oh, what a chance! Murillo (Nottingham) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the crossbar.
45+3' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Ola Aina (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
41' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
38' Chris Wood (Nottingham) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
36' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
35' Nuno Espirito Santo is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Neco Williams suffers an injury and Gonzalo Montiel (Nottingham) comes on.
32' 0 - 1 Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
32' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
31' The game is interrupted now, Neco Williams (Nottingham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
29' Chris Wood (Nottingham) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Chris Wood (Nottingham) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
28' The game is interrupted as Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is flagged offside.
24' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
23' Simon Hooper blows for a foul after Danilo (Nottingham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
22' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
17' Ederson (Manchester City) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
17' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
16' Danilo (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

16' Danilo (Nottingham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Nottingham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

15' Ederson pulls off a great save to deny Neco Williams (Nottingham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play. Nottingham win a corner kick.

15' What a chance that is! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
14' The corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared away by the defence.
14' The free kick is taken by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but ball is cleared. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
11' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
11' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
10' A player from Manchester City commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
10' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.

9' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Matz Sels is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
3' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
1' Neco Williams (Nottingham) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Simon Hooper is the one to supervise the game today.
